newsitem.title: GERMANY: German DAX closes bourse trade up, banks rally.
newsitem.headline: German DAX closes bourse trade up, banks rally.

text.p: 1245 GMT - Germany's DAX share index closes bourse trade strongly up after renewed takeover speculation in the banking sector drives shares there sharply higher. DAX futures also move well ahead and the dollar pushes up to 1.692 marks after U.S. interest rate rise.
* DAX-30 index closes 68.98 points, 2.06 percent up at 3,418.12, catching up with the post-bourse gains late on Tuesday. June DAX futures up 44 points at 3,438.0.
* Commerzbank, Deutsche and Dresdner all up in bank sector. Bayerische Hypo seen potential takeover target.
